howto.what: 这个技能让Claude成为.NET 8后端专家，能帮你设计、编写和测试使用最小API、整洁架构或云原生微服务的C#代码。它会自动遵循最佳实践，如使用异步操作、记录类型和依赖注入。
howto.when: 当你提到“.NET Core”、“.NET 8”、“ASP.NET Core”、“C# 12”、“最小API”、“Entity Framework Core”、“微服务 .NET”、“CQRS”或“MediatR”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用.NET 8最小API创建一个用户CRUD接口。
用Entity Framework Core和CQRS模式设计一个订单系统。
为我的微服务添加JWT认证和授权策略。
say.note: Claude会配置认证中间件和授权策略。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into a .NET 8 backend expert, helping you design, implement, and test C# code using minimal APIs, clean architecture, or cloud-native microservices. It automatically follows best practices like async/await, record types, and dependency injection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like '.NET Core', '.NET 8', 'ASP.NET Core', 'C# 12', 'minimal API', 'Entity Framework Core', 'microservices .NET', 'CQRS', or 'MediatR'.

say_en.text: Create a CRUD user API using .NET 8 minimal APIs.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Program.cs and related handlers.

say_en.text: Design an order system with EF Core and CQRS pattern.
say_en.note: Claude will provide DbContext, migrations, and MediatR handlers.

say_en.text: Add JWT authentication and authorization policies to my microservice.
say_en.note: Claude will configure auth middleware and policies.
